bugs_found_and_fixed_once_in_shared_temp.defect: compare_array_to_registry() wrote row['my_dots_within_3px_of_theirs'] without 'forward_overlap' or 'halo_coverage', whereas binding_duplicate_decision(rows) filtered exclusively on r.get('forward_overlap') is not None. Passing compare_array_to_registry()['rows'] directly into binding_duplicate_decision() produced fwd == [] and silently returned duplicate=False even when overlap was 1.0000.
bugs_found_and_fixed_once_in_shared_temp.fix: compare_array_to_registry() now emits both 'my_dots_within_3px_of_theirs' and 'forward_overlap' plus 'halo_coverage'; binding_duplicate_decision() reads either field seamlessly and explicitly includes 'stop_required' and 'verdict'.

bugs_found_and_fixed_once_in_shared_temp.defect: 'duplicate_by_rho' tested rho > RHO_LIMIT rather than abs(rho) > RHO_LIMIT, missing inverted surfaces (e.g. 1 - p with rho = -0.95) despite the Parallel-Run Protocol specifying |Spearman rho| > 0.90.
bugs_found_and_fixed_once_in_shared_temp.fix: Updated 'duplicate_by_rho' to bool(rho is not None and abs(rho) > RHO_LIMIT).

bugs_found_and_fixed_once_in_shared_temp.defect: 2D scipy.ndimage.binary_dilation on 3730x3292 masks required ~17 min per 1,103-raster scan; naive ceil decomposition failed for non-integer radii such as radius_px=1.5.
bugs_found_and_fixed_once_in_shared_temp.fix: Replaced with exact separable Euclidean disk decomposition using int(np.floor(radius_px)) and contiguous row-slice ORs; verified bit-for-bit identical across 60 random grids and fractional/integer radii while accelerating full 1,103-raster scans ~3x.
